body.statement: Validation corollary (published Tian--Pearl sanity check). Suppose locally that \(S=1\) almost surely, \(X\perp U\) under \(P_{\vartheta}\), and \(P_{\vartheta}(U=3)=0\). Then the atlas value reduces to the Tian--Pearl formulas \(\mathrm{PN}=\{P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=1)-P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=0)\}/P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=1)\) and \(\mathrm{PS}=\{P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=1)-P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=0)\}/P_{\vartheta}(Y=0\mid X=0)\). These three hypotheses are local to this validation corollary and are not conditions on either main design.
body.justification: This is a validation reduction to the published classical formulas, not a claimed research contribution.
body.gap: Tian and Pearl (2000) already establish the benchmark; the only role here is to verify that the atlas preserves it.
body.consumer: Implementers can use the classical formulas as a regression test for the generalized certificates.
body.proof_tex:
Write \(\pi_i=P_{\vartheta}(U=i)\).  Response consistency and \(X\perp U\) give
\[
P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=1)=\pi_1+\pi_2,
\qquad
P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=0)=\pi_1+\pi_3=\pi_1,
\]
where the last equality uses \(P_{\vartheta}(U=3)=0\).  Therefore the risk difference is \(\pi_2\).  The events \((X,Y)=(1,1)\) and \((X,Y)=(0,0)\) have positive probability because \(S=1\) and the selected table is positive, so the following divisions are legitimate.  Again by randomization and response consistency,
\[
\mathrm{PN}
=P_{\vartheta}(U=2\mid X=1,Y=1)
=\frac{\pi_2}{\pi_1+\pi_2}
=\frac{P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=1)-P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=0)}{P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=1)},
\]
and
\[
\mathrm{PS}
=P_{\vartheta}(U=2\mid X=0,Y=0)
=\frac{\pi_2}{\pi_2+\pi_4}
=\frac{P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=1)-P_{\vartheta}(Y=1\mid X=0)}{P_{\vartheta}(Y=0\mid X=0)}.
\]
This calculation applies to every SCM in the restricted randomized monotone submodel.  If the unrestricted target set \(\mathcal T_A(p,m)\) is a singleton and contains the displayed \(\vartheta\), its sole element must equal \(\tau(\vartheta)\), so it equals the same pair.  No rigidity of the unrestricted fiber was inferred from randomization and monotonicity alone.
